title: One-Pot Roasted Greek Khus Khus Tzatziki
description: A crispy, one-pot Greek dish featuring semolina halva and a refreshing tzatziki sauce, made in a traditional kadhai vessel.
instructions: Heat the kadhai over medium-high heat and add the olive oil. Roast the semolina halva for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted.
Add the garlic, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add the Greek yogurt, stirring constantly, until the mixture reaches a smooth consistency.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the grated cucumber, lemon juice, and parsley. Stir well to combine.
Transfer the kadhai to a serving plate and garnish with the lemon zest and additional parsley, if desired.
Tzatziki sauce can be served immediately or refrigerated for up to 24 hours.
Serve with the roasted semolina halva and garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
